categories.main_business_segments: FEED ONE operates three main business segments: Livestock Feed (manufacturing and sales of compound feed, production and sales of pork and eggs), Aquatic Feed (manufacturing and sales of compound feed for aquaculture, procurement and sales of marine products), and Food (procurement, processing, and sales of meat and eggs). The company also engages in other activities such as real estate leasing and overseas feed manufacturing through affiliates.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced nutrition science, breeding information, and proprietary feed formulation technologies for livestock and aquaculture. It emphasizes R&D in environmentally friendly products, IoT integration for efficiency, and the development of alternative raw materials (e.g., low/zero fishmeal feed, methane-reducing cattle feed). Production is supported by modernized, large-scale manufacturing facilities and rigorous quality control systems, including ISO/IEC17025-certified laboratories.
categories.primary_customers_markets: FEED ONE primarily serves domestic livestock and aquaculture producers, including pig, poultry, dairy, and fish farmers. Its end markets are the Japanese food supply chain, with some overseas exposure through affiliates in Vietnam and India. The company also supplies processed food products to wholesalers, retailers, and food service companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, with manufacturing and sales networks spanning Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kansai, and Kyushu. Internationally, it has affiliated feed manufacturing operations in Vietnam and India, and exports technology and products to select overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: FEED ONE is positioned midstream and downstream in the food supply chain, supplying compound feed to livestock and aquaculture producers and further integrating downstream into food processing and sales. It also procures raw materials upstream, mainly through imports.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the core livestock and aquatic feed businesses, enhancing synergies with the food segment, and expanding overseas. R&D focuses on sustainability (e.g., GHG reduction, alternative raw materials), productivity improvements via IoT and automation, and developing products that address customer challenges such as animal health and environmental impact. The company is investing in new facilities and updating existing ones to support these initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of compound feed, livestock and aquaculture products, and processed food items. Additional revenue streams include real estate leasing and, to a lesser extent, overseas joint ventures. Revenue is recognized upon delivery or transfer of control to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: FEED ONE is one of Japan’s leading feed manufacturers, competing with other major domestic players in the livestock and aquaculture feed markets. It leverages scale, integrated value chain capabilities, and strong relationships with producers to maintain a competitive position. The company is also differentiated by its focus on sustainability and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, consolidated net sales were ¥296.0 billion, with operating profit of ¥6.3 billion and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of ¥5.4 billion. The company has a stable financial base, with total assets of ¥124.2 billion and equity ratio of 44%. While sales declined slightly year-on-year due to market conditions, profitability improved, and the company is targeting moderate growth through its mid-term plan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: FEED ONE emphasizes the stable supply of safe, high-quality feed and food products, supporting Japan’s food security and sustainability. Its value proposition includes integrated solutions from feed to food, advanced R&D for customer productivity and environmental compliance, and a strong commitment to ESG and stakeholder trust. Differentiation is achieved through proprietary technologies, a robust domestic network, and a focus on sustainable, next-generation feed products.
